verbalization: The compound in question, (2R,3S,4S,5R,6R)-2-[[(2R,3R,4R)-3,4-dihydroxy-4-(hydroxymethyl)oxolan-2-yl]oxymethyl]-6-[(2S)-4-(4-hydroxyphenyl)butan-2-yl]oxyoxane-3,4,5-triol, is suggested to interact with Phosphodiesterase 6C based on the provided evidence.
